title: Paul in Corinth
description: Paulus comes to Corinth and stays with the tentmakers Aquila and Priscilla, who had recently come from Italy. He speaks every Sabbath in the synagogue, and when Silas and Timothy arrive, he testifies to the Jews that Jesus is the Messiah. After opposition, he turns to the Gentiles. The synagogue ruler Crispus and many Corinthians come to faith and are baptized. After a vision from the Lord, Paul remains for a year and a half. The Jews bring him before the proconsul Gallio, who dismisses the case, and Sosthenes is beaten in front of the judge's seat.

versions.title: Paul in Corinth
versions.description: Paul lives with the tentmakers Aquila and Priscilla and preaches the gospel in Corinth for a year and a half.

versions.title: Paul in Corinth
versions.description: Paul arrives in Corinth, stays and works with the tentmakers Aquila and Priscilla, and preaches in the synagogue. After facing opposition, he turns to the Gentiles, and many Corinthians come to faith. Following a vision from the Lord, he remains there for a year and a half until the Jews bring him before the proconsul Gallio, who dismisses the case.
